name: acute infantile liver failure-cerebellar ataxia-peripheral sensory motor neuropathy syndrome
description: An autosomal recessive cerebellar ataxia that has material basis in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the SCYL1 gene on chromosome 11q13.
